greeting.text: Oh, do you have a dog? Or a cat?

lines.text: Mine is fourteen. Her joints aren't great lately.
A cat? How old? What's the name?
The vet here is really thorough. Don't worry.
The shedding is unreal, right? My whole place is fur.
Got a picture? Show me, show me!

flushRemark.text: Oh, you're blushing. I must've been too excited.

closers.satisfied: Say hi to your cat for me~
closers.endured: Oh, it's our turn. See you~
closers.awkward: …Mm, take good care of your cat.
